items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, I believe George Gano told me once that Sam Morgan used to use the slapstick too. Did you ever hear their band? Yeah, I heard their band. [INTERVIEWEE] Sam Morgan.

ctx.x: Well, I just, well, Mr. Bill, I just, sometime I, I've been doing that, you know, sometime I used to use that rubber spludger. Yeah, plunger. I used to use that long time ago. Then sometime I used to take a coffee can, you know what I mean? I'd make a, take a coffee can. I'd take that coffee can and I'd cut, I'd cut on the top of it so it could fit right on top of my bell. Oh yeah. You know what I mean? And sometimes take a tin can, a little tin can, you know what I mean? Small tin, milk can, you know? Yeah. And…
Oh, I believe George Gano told me once that Sam Morgan used to use the slapstick too. Did you ever hear their band? Yeah, I heard their band.
